public_definitions: Use the dashboard trend to route this inpatient capacity review to the most appropriate operations pathway for the current period.
The chart displays the trend of COVID-19 hospital census over time, from Feb 24, 2020, to Mar 14, 2020.

The options for routing are: 'Route to hospital surge-capacity planning guidance for rapidly increasing COVID-19 inpatient demand', 'Route to step-down recovery planning for easing COVID-19 inpatient demand', and 'Route to routine respiratory surveillance updates for background monitoring'.
